note:
Replaces Isidore Begun's photograph with the 1937 portrait from his Wikipedia article.

THE LICENCE WAS CHECKED, AND THIS ONE IS CLEAR. The image is hosted on Wikimedia Commons rather than on the English Wikipedia, and its file page states that it is in the public domain in the United States, having been published there between 1931 and 1977 without a copyright notice. The author is given as the Daily Worker and the source as the Daily Worker and Daily World Photographs Collection. That is a different situation from César Andreu Iglesias in batch 156, whose Wikipedia portrait is non-free and was therefore not copied.

The existing photograph is 272 by 404 pixels. The replacement is 1099 by 1400, resized down from a 2289 by 2916 original of 3.7 MB — too heavy to serve — and re-encoded at quality 86 to about 300 KB with the EXIF stripped, which also removes the editing-software and timestamp metadata the uploader left in it.

The old file is NOT overwritten. The new photograph is stored under its own name and the record repointed, so prisoners/isidore-begun.jpg stays on disk and the change can be undone by resetting one field.
